title: Clickable Icons (Vertical)
body:
This is an excellent example of a Click and Learn component that displays five icons arranged horizontally. On clicking these icons, the corresponding content for each icon is presented vertically in a box below the icon. It includes an optional body text above the clickable icons.
On tablet devices, the component resizes without any changes in layout.
On smartphones, the content for each icon is presented in an overlapping pop up box.
instruction: Click each icon to learn more.

_items.title: What is a component?
_items.body: In Adapt we have a concept of components. These components are the main interactive elements found on a page. (Multiple Choice Question, Media, Text and Narrative are all types of components). These components can be split into two categories.

_items.title: Presentational components
_items.body: A presentational component should be used to display content with little interactivity. A few components that full under this category are: Graphic, Media, Hot Graphic and Narrative.
